fisher-yu.name: Deep-water route
fisher-yu.prompt: The channel markers have lost their labels. Help me mark a safe route through deep water for the whale.
fisher-yu.found: Fisher Yu has marked the deep-water channel. The rescue crew knows where to sail.

maker-chen.name: Water depth
maker-chen.prompt: My tide gauge has muddled its instructions. Help me measure how deep the water must be for the whale.
maker-chen.found: Maker Chen's tide gauge is working again. The crew knows how deep the water must be.

watcher-an.name: The right moment
watcher-an.prompt: The old clock records disagree. Help me find the right moment for the whale to leave the shallows.
watcher-an.found: Watcher An has checked the old records. The crew knows when the tide should rise.

arrival.speaker: Keeper Lan
arrival.say: Welcome to Tidewater Bay. The Great Forgetter has stopped our Clock Tower, and the sea can no longer remember when to rise or fall.

arrival.speaker: Keeper Lan
arrival.say: A young whale is stranded in the shallows. Collect Word Spirits and speak to Fisher Yu about the route, Maker Chen about the depth, and Watcher An about the tide. Then bring their clues to me.

compare.speaker: Keeper Lan
compare.say: Fisher Yu found the route, Maker Chen measured the depth, and Watcher An checked the hour. But these clues cannot all be right while the Clock Tower stands still.

compare.speaker: Keeper Lan
compare.say: The Harbour Chronometer confirms it: the Idle Clock is holding part of the bay at the wrong moment. Free more Word Spirits, then find the Tide Pavilion beyond town.

reform.speaker: Idle Clock
reform.say: I let every useful moment drift away. If time never moves, no one can finish what they begin.

reform.speaker: Keeper Lan
reform.say: The clock is moving again! The route, depth, and timing we found can guide the young whale home. Come back to the Rescue Dock.

reform.speaker: Spirit Brush
reform.say: Current Stroke restored. The hidden Tide Vault can now be opened.

rescue.speaker: Fisher Yu
rescue.say: The channel markers are clear. Steer between them and the whale will reach deep water.

rescue.speaker: Maker Chen
rescue.say: The gauge says the water is deep enough. We can guide her now.

rescue.speaker: Watcher An
rescue.say: The tower has started turning. This is the right moment.

rescue.speaker: Keeper Lan
rescue.say: There she goes! You helped the whole harbour work together. The whale is safe, and Tidewater Bay remembers its rhythm.
